title: Writing / Style / Bold
slide_intent: Mark named interface targets within prose so readers can identify what to select or visit.
strategic_value: Bold UI references can help Duolingo connect explanatory sentences to visible product actions.
demonstration: Two checked instructions emphasize the interface names View more and Achievements within otherwise regular-weight sentences.
practical_value: Bold the actual UI element or action being referenced in an instruction.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the topic heading, its parent label and the written convention in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Place the worked copy in the pale right panel, keeping preference labels and green checks with their examples.

reference_purposes.Application: The examples emphasize the named interface targets inside complete instructions.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Use bold for references to UI elements or actions.
